name: EPATADA
description: This R package can be used to compile and evaluate Water Quality Portal (WQP) data for samples collected from surface water monitoring sites on streams and lakes. It can be used to create applications that support water quality programs and help states, tribes, and other stakeholders efficiently analyze the data.

paragraphs: Tools for Automated Data Analysis, or TADA, is being developed to help States, Tribes (i.e., Tribal Nations, Pueblos, Bands, Rancherias, Communities, Colonies, Towns, Indians, Villages), federal partners, and other Water Quality Portal (WQP) users (e.g. researchers) efficiently compile and evaluate WQP data collected from water quality monitoring sites. TADA is both a stand-alone R package, and a building block to support development of R Shiny applications such as TADAShiny.
features: More information on how TADA leverages the WQX QAQC Service
